errors.endpoint_invalid: the MCP server announced a message endpoint the proxy cannot read ({endpoint})
errors.endpoint_other_origin: the MCP server announced a message endpoint on another origin ({endpoint}); the proxy only posts back to the server it streams from
errors.invalid_message: MCP server {server} only takes calls the run's allowlist can check: send one JSON-RPC 2.0 message or batch, UTF-8, with no repeated keys
errors.read_body: could not read the request body
errors.tool_not_allowed: tool {tool} of {server} is not in this run's allowlist
errors.unknown_session: no MCP session with that id for this run; open a new stream
errors.upstream_not_sse: MCP server {server} did not answer with an event stream (status {status}); check the registration's transport
errors.upstream_refused: MCP server {server} refused the daemon's credentials (status {status}); an operator has to fix its registration or credential
errors.oauth_unavailable: MCP server {server} uses an OAuth connection, and OAuth connections are not set up on this daemon
errors.credential_refused: the credential for MCP server {server} was refused ({reason}): {detail}
errors.renew_failed: could not renew the credential for MCP server {server}
